== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rogue Bantha (Japanese)|Rogue Bantha]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157709609/SlfbwMxGQ0SI1XOt0KLsUg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 90960113.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b29425a95c3df814ba09b317aac1117d91cdadefc8f02ffb9f39389d8a2b8e4a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
